fn countLessValue(n: Int, m: Int, target: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (m >= 1)
  requires (target >= 1)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 0 else ((if ((if (((target - 1) / n) > m) then m else ((target - 1) / n)) >= 1) then if (((target - 1) / n) > m) then m else ((target - 1) / n) else 0) + countLessValue((n - 1), m, target))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result <= (n * m))
  effects pure
  example (countLessValue(0, 1, 1) == 0)
  example (countLessValue(1, 1, 2) == 1)

fn countLessOrEqualValue(n: Int, m: Int, target: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (m >= 1)
  requires (target >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (target <= 0) then 0 else if (target >= (n * m)) then (n * m) else countLessValue(n, m, (target + 1))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result <= (n * m))
